name: cutout-card

frames.best_why: Hover is active: the card is lifted with a deeper shadow and the whole layout is unobstructed.

tagline: Rounded photo card lifts its shadow and zooms the image on hover.
summary: A media card with a photo, cut-out corner labels, a title, description and footer, whose image scales and shadow deepens when the pointer enters.
appearance: A rounded dark card: a code photo fills the top half, with a New tag pinned to its top-right and a Featured label cut into its bottom-left edge. Below, a light title, two lines of grey copy and a small footer sit on the card surface.
behaviour: On hover the whole card lifts with a deeper shadow and the photo scales up slightly; leaving settles it back. Labels and text stay fixed.
demo_content: Code on a screen, labels New and Featured, title Developer Toolkit, footer 12 components and View.
search_phrases: photo card that lifts on hover
product card with a new badge
card with cutout corners around a tag
media tile with image zoom on hover
picture card with title and view link
card whose shadow grows when hovered
use_when: Show a photo or project thumbnail with a couple of status tags and a link, and reward hover.
avoid_when: Hover is the only cue; touch screens get no zoom or lift, and the media area needs a fixed height.
customise: Labels, actions and content are composed from exported parts and accept class names; the photo, shadow depth and hover timing need demo or source edits.
weight_why: One image and a few transforms that run only while hovered.

a11y.note: Effects fire only on pointer hover and the card is not focusable, so keyboard users never see the lift or any hidden action.

issues: Hover effects never trigger on touch devices.
The card shows a pointer cursor and lifts, but it has no link or click handler.
polish_why: Crisp cut-out tags and a smooth hover lift; the pointer cursor leads nowhere.
